title: 以为审查很严？：顾问纹身没发现，帖子只给一部分
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now to talk about next steps ahead of this crucial Senate race is Bloomberg's Boston, Bureau Chief Brooke Sutherland Brooke.
segments.zh: 现在加入我们的是彭博社波士顿分社社长布鲁克·萨瑟兰，来谈谈这场关键参议院选举的下一步。

segments.en: Thank you so much for coming to join us. I do wanna ask, it seems like some of these things should have been or frankly were discoverable before they decided to run him as a candidate.
segments.zh: 非常感谢你的到来。我想问的是，有些问题在决定让他参选之前就应该被发现，或者说实际上是可以发现的。

segments.en: I wanna play you some sound from some campaign advisers who spoke to the Wall Street Journal.
segments.zh: 我想播放一段竞选顾问接受《华尔街日报》采访的录音。

segments.en: Did the vetting process turn up the tattoo that became so controversial?
segments.zh: 审查过程中是否发现了那个引发争议的纹身？

segments.en: No. The Reddit posts, did that turn up in the vetting process?
segments.zh: 没有。Reddit上的帖子呢？审查过程中发现了吗？

segments.en: The firms sent us a thing and it had some of the pias, but it didn't have all of them.
segments.zh: 公司发来的材料里有一些帖子，但不是全部。

segments.en: And what did you think about that? How did you think your way through the fact that he had posted these things on social media?
segments.zh: 你怎么看？对于他在社交媒体上发布这些内容，你是怎么考虑的？

segments.en: I said none of this. Will or should I stop him from becoming a US Senator?
segments.zh: 我说这些都不应该，也不会阻止他成为美国参议员。

segments.en: So that was Platon or should I just Danny Moraf saying, this is the higher to firm to vet the candidate as they do.
segments.zh: 那是普拉顿，或者说丹尼·莫拉夫在说，这是他们聘请来审查候选人的公司。

segments.en: And it seems like after that excruciatingly long pause, some of this stuff was known.
segments.zh: 在那段漫长的停顿之后，似乎有些情况已经为人所知。

segments.en: Is it clear what they knew what they didn't know and why they decided to make the decision to go ahead and put him forward as a candidate?
segments.zh: 他们清楚自己知道什么、不知道什么吗？为何决定推他做候选人？

segments.en: I think all of those details are still coming to light that's certainly a lot of frustration on the part of Democrats.
segments.zh: 这些细节还在浮出水面，民主党人确实很沮丧。

segments.en: I mean, I think what's important to remember here is just how crucial this race is.
segments.zh: 重要的是，这场竞选至关重要。
